content: च्यु I. €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> (च्यवते, च्युत) .²1 To fall or drop down, slip, sink (<ab>fig.</ab> also); <ls>Ś. 2. 8</ls>. .²2 To come out of, flow or issue from, drop, trickle or stream forth from; स्वतश्च्युतं वह्निमिवाद्भिरम्बुदः <ls>R. 3. 58</ls>; <ls>Bk. 9. 71</ls>. .²3 To deviate or swerve from, fall off or away from, leave (duty <ab>&c.</ab>); (with <ab>abl.</ab>) अस्माद्धर्मान्न च्यवेत <ls>Ms. 7. 98</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">12. 71-72</ls>. .²4 To lose, be deprived of; अच्योष्ट सत्त्वान्नृपतिः <ls>Bk. 3. 20</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">7. 92</ls>. .²5 To vanish, disappear, perish, be at an end; <ls>R. 8. 66</ls>; <ls>Ms. 12. 96</ls>. .²6 To decrease. .²7 To bring about, make, form, create. .²8 To cause to go away, cause to forget. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (च्यावयति-ते) .²1 To cause to move, excite, agitate. .²2 (<ab>Ā.</ab>) To move oneself, be shaken or moved. .²3 To remove, drive away, expel. .²4 To deprive, take away; <ls>Pt. 1. 240</ls>. .²5 To cause to fall. --II. €10 <ab>P.</ab> (च्यावयति) .²1 To suffer, bear. .²2 To laugh.
